posts.post:
I'm a mess, really low, no one even gives a shit and no one to help
I'm depressed as fuck because I'm all alone yet I can't go out and make friends because no one wants to be around a depressed person. (even if i was successful) I'm basically a lepor at this point.  My day nowadays consists of sleeping 12 hours, taking two hours to get up out of bed, then trying to force myself to do something and failing.  Then I have a tension headache/migraine and just want to go to sleep.  I read people online say to just stick through it and it will get better, it's only getting worse, the worst part is knowing there is no one that even cares or no one to help.  I"m somehow supposed to pull myself out of this alone when I don't even have it in me to watch tv anymore.  This post has been a week in the making.     I tried to get 'help' but insurance didn't want to cover meds and then my psychiatrist stopped responding.  I don't know if I can hold out longer

Watching LOTR for first time, Gollum is exactly what's going on in my head...
I'm not schizophrenic, but this [scene](https://38.media.tumblr.com/tumblr_lhxgdwFO4c1qhxr17o1_500.gif) is exactly what goes on in my head.  Is this anyone else or am I just really fucked up?

Well Vegas is really depressing...
Does everyone get laid here or is it just some overstated thing?    I heard some girl hooked up with some dude at starbucks after two girls walked onto elevator, everyone is freaking hot as hell, I have now idea how people can do it so easily.

I'm really depressed and don't know what to do.
I've been depressed for years, I had some really bad spots.  First time I went through a few anti depressants and had negative reactions to all of them and swore them off.  Recently over the holidays, I got really down again, it got really bad, and I went to psychiatrist again.  She prescribed me some stuff but insurance gave me the run around and she didn't really help with alternatives and I just gave up.  All I do is think about death all the time, how I'm going to die, how there is no point to anything, suicidal thoughts. Everything makes me sad. It's really hard for me to get going most of the time, I've basically done nothing for years, I don't find joy in anything.  When I do, it's just like what do I even do?  I've tried most of the cliche advice given to me, I'm alone and I hate it, I have no friends, no one to talk to, just rummage through my head.  Then at same time even if I did try, no one would want to be around me because I'm depressed.  I'm damned if I do, damned if I don't.  I feel stuck, I have no idea wtf to do at this point.

Life just sucks, I'm stuck, and I don't even know how Im supposed to make it better
I told myself last month I'd try to be more social, then I realized I don't even know wtf to do.  I see everyone else becoming more successful then me and doing well (job wise) while I've kind of stagnated.  Even when I start to motivate myself I realize "even if you had one billion dollars put into your bank account tomorrow you'd still be miserable"  I then lost motivation, and then shit all over myself for not doing as well as others.  I feel like I have all the time in the world with nothing to do.  It seems like weeks and months fly by and I do nothing.  I just can't get motivation.  I tried getting help but psychologist didn't help, and psychiatrist honestly blew.  Now I can't stay in one spot too long and don't even know what to do.
